title: Make gate mutations and next fully subject-aware
goal: Ensure every gate mutation and next-step recommendation reflects the actual optional and per-epic lifecycle state.
in_scope: Require --subject for approve and reject mutations of G6 and G7
Reject unscoped mutations before writing any gate state
Skip optional G1.5 only when it remains untouched and pending
Return rejected G1.5 as the next unresolved gate
Evaluate G6 and G7 across subject-scoped decisions for every epic in release_in_flight
Ignore stale global G6 and G7 slots when computing next
Keep scripts/gate.mjs and the bootstrap scaffold copy behaviorally identical
out_of_scope: Making G1.5 mandatory when it was intentionally omitted
Changing the meaning of approved, rejected, or pending for global gates
Adding remote tracker state as a second source of gate truth
acceptance: approve and reject require --subject for G6 and G7 and leave gate state unchanged when it is omitted; gate next skips G1.5 only while the optional gate is untouched and pending, surfaces an explicit G1.5 rejection, and derives G6/G7 readiness from subject-scoped decisions for every epic in the current release rather than stale global slots.
invariants: .throughline/gates.json remains the sole gate-state source of truth
One epic's decision never authorizes another epic
Failed CLI validation never partially mutates gate state
Bare checks and mutations remain valid for non-subject gates
